about_short_description.short_description: Esyasoft is a Gartner recognised, CMMi Level 3 accredited company providing smart utilities and energy efficiency solution.

product.name: Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI)
product.description: A system for automated collection and management of utility meter data to support grid modernization and energy management.

product.name: Meter Data Management (MDM) System
product.description: A software platform for collecting, validating, and managing meter data from various utility sources to support analytics and operational processes.

product.name: IoT Products for Utilities
product.description: A range of Internet of Things devices including smart meters, sensors, and controllers for electricity, water, and gas utility grids.

product.name: Smart Grid Suite
product.description: A cloud-edge platform providing solutions and services for the digital transformation of energy distribution grids.

product.name: Energy Mobility Solutions
product.description: Infrastructure and solutions to support the deployment and management of electric vehicle (EV) charging and related energy services.

product.name: Smart Meter - 3 Phase 4 Wire E350/SM310
product.description: A three-phase smart energy meter with import-export measurement, load control switches, and RF mesh communication for residential and light commercial use.
